inputs.share_count_basis: 3,051.2m = weighted average shares for diluted EPS, H1 FY2026 interim note 10(b) (line 1731). Shares in issue are 3,112.6m (line 481) but ~61m of those are held by the share-award trust and are economically treasury until awarded; awards are charged through the SBC line, so the count is held FLAT at the ex-trust diluted figure (charge SBC once, never both expensed and diluted).
inputs.cash_composition: 30 Jun 2026 (RMB m): cash and cash equivalents 7,122.8 + term deposits 3,333.7 (3,292.1 non-current + 41.6 current) + wealth-management products and structured deposits at FVTPL 4,317.0 = 14,773.5. EXCLUDED: pledged bank deposits 3,557.2 (1,599.0 non-current + 1,958.3 current) because they are security for the RMB 6,858m of bills payable (interim line 421-422, note 14) and are therefore working-capital collateral, not surplus cash. Lease liabilities 155.4 excluded from debt under lease treatment (B). The FY2025 final dividend payable of RMB 1,408.0m (unpaid at 30 Jun 2026, paid July 2026; line 1156) is deducted in equity_bridge.
inputs.interest_income_composition: FY2025 bank interest income 180.7 + net fair-value gains on FVTPL treasury products 179.5 (annual note 7, lines 5090 and 5099). Both are the return on the treasury pile added back in net cash, so both are stripped from the flows (matching-asset rule). Government grants (228.5) and VAT super-deduction (172.6) are operating and are left inside EBITDA.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report cash-flow note 35(a) line 5166: share-based compensation expenses 179,028 (RMB thousand); FY2024 was a net reversal of (46,847). EquityAwardTaxes 0 in every year (no net-share-settlement withholding; RSU vesting brought cash IN of 62.7m in FY2024). H1 FY2026 charge was 1.2m after a 47.3m reversal of awards whose performance conditions will not be met (interim line 2008-2012).
inputs.buyback_note: FY2025 repurchase of shares 48,958 RMB thousand (line 3577); H1 FY2026 26.5m. The June 2026 AGM general mandate (up to 10% of issued shares) is an authorisation, not spend. Flat count is funded: buybacks have roughly offset trust-award releases historically.
inputs.normalized_fcf_note: last_fcf 4,663 is the FY2025 PEAK owner FCF and is NOT the projection base: FY2025 cash generated from operations (6,323) was inflated by a trade-and-bills-payables build (payables 14,099 at FY2025 vs ~9,900 at FY2024) on top of the regulatory pull-forward year, and FY2024 (-1,407 owner FCF) was the mirror-image unwind. The component build re-derives FCF from a mid-cycle EBITDA margin; the base case's year-1 (FY2026) owner FCF is ~RMB 1.1-1.2bn and the mature-year figure ~RMB 2.3bn, i.e. roughly half the FY2025 print.
inputs.fx_note: CNY/HKD 1.1726 (RMB 1 = HK$1.1726), Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X regular close 2026-10-16. Direction: per-share values computed in RMB are MULTIPLIED by 1.1726 to reach the HKD quote basis. Parity check (no dual listing exists): the FY2025 final dividend of HK$0.53 x 3,112.6m shares in issue = HK$1,649.7m was booked as a payable of RMB 1,407.95m at 30 Jun 2026 (interim note 9), implying 1.1717 HKD per CNY, a 0.1% tie to the rate used. Note the filing says RMB; ISO code is CNY.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Flows are CNY, so WACC is built in CNY: 10-year China government bond ~1.8% + 7.0% equity risk premium (mature-market ~5% plus a China country premium) x beta ~1.0 for a domestic consumer durable = ~8.8% cost of equity; borrowings are <5% of capital so WACC ~= cost of equity. Rounded to 9.0%. Same WACC in all three scenarios: cyclicality, the regulatory-pull-forward reversal and the single-market dependency are charged in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked again in the discount rate (risk charged once).
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost: full lease cash (FY2025 principal 59.4 + interest ~6.8 = ~66m, 0.18% of revenue) is charged inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities (155.4 at 30 Jun 2026) are EXCLUDED from total_debt. da_pct_path (1.3%) is depreciation ex right-of-use assets (FY2025 total depreciation 483.7 = 1.31% of revenue, of which ROU ~60m) plus amortisation of land-use rights and software, so the lease is not charged twice.
inputs.nci_treatment: Non-controlling interests are RMB 0.8m at 30 Jun 2026 (immaterial); flows treated as fully attributable, no bridge deduction.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing row: operating company, non-US and cyclical, with the adaptations file applied: CNY/HKD currency bridge, lease treatment B, matching-asset rule for treasury income, SBC-light market, risk charged once). Yadea is a manufacturer, not a bank/REIT/LIC, so the FCF engine is the right frame. FY0 = FY2025 (latest audited year); projection year 1 = FY2026, discounted a full period from the Oct-2026 valuation date even though FY2026 ends in 2.5 months, a small conservatism. MID-CYCLE FRAMING: FY2025 (revenue +31%, EBITDA margin 11.1%, owner FCF 4.7bn) was a one-off regulatory pull-forward (GB 17761-2024 mandatory Sept 2025) plus a payables build; H1 FY2026 already reversed it (revenue -5%, profit -27%, gross margin 17.7% vs 19.6%). Treasury-income-stripped EBITDA margins were 9.4% FY2022, ~9.2% FY2023, 6.3% FY2024, 10.2% FY2025, ~8.7% H1 FY2026; the base case normalises to 9.0% ex-treasury by FY2029 rather than extrapolating 11.1%. FY2026E revenue in the base is -8% (H1 actual -5.0%; H2 compares against the H2 FY2025 pull-forward peak of 17,822 and is assumed -12%). WORKING CAPITAL: trade and bills payables (13.7bn) exceed receivables plus inventory, so the business is payables-funded and growth RELEASES cash while decline CONSUMES it; wc_capture is therefore +10% of the revenue change (positive, the opposite sign to a receivables-heavy manufacturer), which is what makes the FY2026 revenue decline cost cash in year 1 as H1 FY2026 showed (OCF 1,626 vs 4,727). Buyback mechanics: flat count is funded by modest repurchases (49m FY2025). Known repo issue: sanity_check.py applies fx_rate in the wrong direction on CNY/HKD tickers (see memory, 0288.HK and 1415.HK precedent); if its printed multiples look ~1.37x off, that is the checker, not the model.

equity_bridge.item: FY2025 final dividend payable at 30 Jun 2026 (HK$0.53/share, paid July 2026)
equity_bridge.note: Interim report line 1156 / note 9: dividends payable RMB 1,407,952 thousand. Cash on the balance sheet still included it; deducted so the cash pile is post-distribution.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: mid-cycle judgment, not a trailing CAGR
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR 16.3% diverges >30% from revenue 3yr CAGR 6.0%; every trailing CAGR ending FY2025 is inflated by the regulatory pull-forward peak and the FY2024 trough (owner FCF -1,407 in FY2024 to +4,663 in FY2025), so none is a usable forward proxy. Selected 4.0% is the base case's mid-horizon revenue growth (FY2028-FY2031 average).
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - bank interest income; FVTPL gains additionally stripped where disclosed, FY2024-25): FY2020 1,415; FY2021 2,182; FY2022 2,104; FY2023 1,842; FY2024 -1,407; FY2025 4,663. SBC-adjusted and reported CAGRs are close because SBC is <0.5% of revenue; the distortion here is working capital, not SBC. CAGRs computed FY2022->FY2025 (3yr) and FY2020->FY2025 (5yr) from metrics_normalized.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 -8% (H1 -5.0% actual, H2 assumed -12% against the pull-forward comp). FY2027 +3% as domestic demand stabilises on new-standard products, FY2028-29 +5% (mix/ASP, battery replacement cycle on the enlarged installed base, Vietnam ramp), fading to 3% by FY2033. The China market is ~59m units and mature; Yadea's 16m units cannot compound at the 14% 5yr revenue CAGR again.
base.margin_rationale: EBITDA margin is EX treasury income (interest and FVTPL gains stripped). 8.3% FY2026 (H1 ~8.7% ex-treasury, H2 weaker on volume deleverage), normalising to 9.0% by FY2029: the FY2022-25 ex-treasury average is ~8.8%, FY2025's 10.2% was the peak. Below the reported 11.1% FY2025 EBITDA margin by design.
base.capex_rationale: FY2026 2.2% (H1 actual 316m = 1.7%; Vietnam plant largely spent), then 3.0% for FY2027-28 (Indonesia expansion, Vietnam phase 2 to 2m units), tapering to 2.5% long-run vs the FY2020-25 average of 3.6% which included the domestic capacity build to >20m units that is now complete.
base.tax_rationale: Cash tax 20% on EBIT: FY2024 effective 19.6%, FY2025 19.0% (15% high-tech rate on key subsidiaries, 25% elsewhere, plus PRC dividend withholding tax on upstreaming to the HK holdco). Cash tax paid lags the charge (333 paid vs 683 charged FY2025) so 20% is slightly conservative vs the recent cash rate.
base.terminal_rationale: 2.5% nominal CNY, below China nominal GDP. Cap 14x terminal FCF: cyclical, single-market consumer durable; a lower cap than the 20x house default for compounders.

scenario_narratives.base: The FY2025 New-National-Standard pull-forward fully unwinds through FY2026 (revenue -8%, e-bicycle volumes down ~38% in H1 only partly offset by e-scooters up ~64%), then the domestic market settles at ~55-60m units with Yadea holding its ~28% share as the standard squeezes sub-scale rivals. Growth thereafter is ASP/mix (Modern and Guanneng series, sodium-ion), the battery-replacement annuity on a 16m-unit-a-year installed base, and a Vietnam/Indonesia contribution that reaches mid-single-digit percent of volume by FY2030 rather than transforming the group. Ex-treasury EBITDA margin normalises to 9.0%, between the FY2024 trough (6.3%) and FY2025 peak (10.2%). Capex steps up for the SE Asian plants in FY2027-28 then settles at 2.5% of revenue.
scenario_narratives.bull: H2 FY2026 recovers faster than management's 'gradual' language implies as consumers accept new-standard products, and the standard delivers the consolidation management expects: Yadea and Aima take share from Tailing, Luyuan and smaller brands, so FY2027-29 revenue compounds at 6-8%. Premium mix, vertical integration and scale push ex-treasury EBITDA margin to 10.5% (just above the FY2025 peak, sustained rather than one-off). Vietnam scales to 2m units and Indonesia follows, lifting overseas to >10% of volume, and the gasoline-to-electric conversion in SE Asia (helped by elevated fuel prices) becomes a second growth leg. Terminal growth 3.0%, cap 16x.
scenario_narratives.bear: The pull-forward reversal is deeper and longer: FY2026 -12% and FY2027 -3% as trade-in subsidies lapse and e-bicycle demand does not return at the old volume. Segway-Ninebot (+64% volume in 2025) and Aima turn the smart-scooter category into a price war, pushing ex-treasury EBITDA margin back to the FY2024 7.0-7.5% band permanently. Overseas stays ~2% of volume against entrenched gasoline incumbents. Growth then tracks replacement demand at 2% with no re-rating. The payables float partly unwinds as volume falls (wc_capture +10% makes the FY2026-27 declines consume cash). Terminal growth 2.0%, cap 12x. Not a solvency scenario: net cash exceeds RMB 12bn after the dividend, so the bear case is about earnings power, not survival.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear lifted from the 15% house default to 30%: ~98% of volume depends on one market whose demand has just been shown to swing on a single regulatory event, FY2024 proved the margin can halve in a downturn, and the H1 FY2026 reversal is still in progress with no quantified guidance. Bull cut to 20% because it needs three independent things (domestic consolidation, a sustained above-peak margin, and SE Asia scaling from 2% of volume) to go right at once; years of 'go global' effort have delivered only ~300k overseas units. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: SBC is ~0.3% of revenue, so the house/street band is only ~HK$0.6 wide (14.28 vs 14.90 weighted) and the price sits far below both ends; band_position is therefore a large negative number with no useful reading. The accounting regime for comp is not what the market is pricing here; the discount is to the operations and the cash pile.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Mid-cycle owner-FCF DCF on treasury-income-stripped margins, deliberately below the FY2025 regulatory-pull-forward peak that H1 FY2026 has already begun to reverse. About a third of the base-case equity value (RMB 12.6bn of 37.8bn, HK$4.83 of 14.53 per share) is the post-dividend net cash (cash, term deposits and liquid wealth-management products; pledged deposits backing bills payable are excluded), which is why the valuation is less sensitive to the operating assumptions than the headline upside suggests. The operations are valued at a 14x terminal cap on ~RMB 2.3bn of mature owner FCF, a mid-cycle multiple for a cyclical single-market consumer durable with the #1 share.
key_risks_to_valuation: The FY2026 reversal runs deeper than -8%: H2 FY2026 compares against the pull-forward peak and management offers only qualitative 'gradual recovery' guidance.

Payables-funded cash: trade and bills payables of RMB 13.7bn fund part of the RMB 14.8bn treasury pile; a sustained volume decline would unwind the float (modelled via positive wc_capture, but the balance-sheet stock is counted in full except for the pledged deposits).
Price competition from Segway-Ninebot and Aima in smart e-scooters compresses margins toward the FY2024 6-7% band rather than the 9% base assumption.
China trade-in subsidies and the New National Standard are policy variables; a further standard change or subsidy withdrawal creates another air-pocket.
Treasury products (RMB 4.3bn at FVTPL, some linked to gold/FX) are counted at carrying value; a mark-down would hit the bridge directly.
CNY/HKD rate: the quote-currency IV moves one-for-one with the FX rate, which refresh_price.py does not update.
